content: अपलपनम्, -अपलापः .²1 Concealing, hiding; कृततिग्मद्युतिमण्डलापलापैः <ls>Śi. 20. 28</ls>. .²2 Concealment or denial of knowledge, evasion; न हि प्रत्यक्षसिद्धस्यापलापः कर्तुं शक्यते <ls>Ś. B.</ls> .²3 Detraction, concealment of truth, thoughts, feelings <ab>&c.</ab>; उन्मुखदर्शनापलपनैः पिण्डार्थमायस्यतः <ls>Mu. 3. 14</ls>. .²4 Affection, regard. .²5 (In medicine) The part between the shoulder and the ribs.
